description: Fail-open verification defect: /api/lex/verify-citation asked LLM to guess active status and defaulted to ACTIVE and VERIFIED on failure.
evidence: catch block returned status: 'ACTIVE', isLatestEdition: true, confidence: 'VERIFIED' even when source was unavailable or article didn't exist.
remediation: Redesigned /api/lex/verify-citation with deterministic CitationValidator and LegalCacheManager; returns explicit SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and UNVERIFIED upon errors.

description: Fail-open offline helper: synthesizeOfflineLexVerification hardcoded status: 'ACTIVE' and isLatestEdition: true.
evidence: Function hardcoded status: 'ACTIVE' regardless of whether article was located or valid.
remediation: Replaced with validateCitation engine that validates against authoritative snapshot and sets accurate verdict.

description: Unconditional assignment of isLexVerified: true and status: 'CURRENT' in legal consultation endpoint.
evidence: parsed.legalBasis.map unconditionally set isLexVerified = true and status = 'CURRENT' for any citation returned by LLM.
remediation: Implemented validateCitation pipeline: only provisions verified in force receive isLexVerified: true and status: 'CURRENT'; repealed or unknown norms receive REPEALED or UNVERIFIED.

description: verifyCitationWithLexDb returned status: 'ACTIVE' and confidence: 'VERIFIED' when no article matched in database.
evidence: Fallback block returned status: 'ACTIVE', statusLabel: 'Lex.uz: Amaldagi tahrir (2026)', confidence: 'VERIFIED' for unknown articles.
remediation: Changed fallback to return status: 'UNVERIFIED', statusLabel: 'Tasdiqlanmagan', confidence: 'UNVERIFIED', isLatestEdition: false.

description: Frontend UI badge defaulted to green verified state upon network failure.
evidence: catch block in performVerification set status: 'ACTIVE' and default switch case displayed green verified badge.
remediation: Updated catch block to set SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and UNVERIFIED; added distinct badges for REPEALED, REVISED, ARTICLE_NOT_FOUND, and UNVERIFIED; green badge only rendered for ACTIVE verified in-force norms.

description: Version stamp comparator defaulted lexCurrentStatus to CURRENT and isVersionMatch to true for unindexed articles.
evidence: If dbMatch was not found in laws database, comparator did not flag mismatch or missing article.
remediation: Integrated validateCitation directly into compareMetadataVersionStamps: unindexed or missing articles fail closed to UNVERIFIED with isVersionMatch = false.

description: Duplicated endpoint: app.post('/api/gemini/transcribe') defined twice in server.ts.
evidence: Line 1001 and line 1587 both registered the same route, leading to ambiguous routing behavior.
remediation: Removed redundant route registration at line 1587 and consolidated transcription logic.

description: Lack of temporal sensitivity in court duty and macro calculations: fixed BHM of 412,000 UZS used for all dates.
evidence: Historical disputes from 2021-2023 were computed using 2024/2026 BHM, yielding inaccurate court fees.
remediation: Created MacroValuesService with full historical BHM and MHTEKM registries (PF-5723, PF-6155, PF-6279, PF-138, PF-45, PF-196, PF-108); added interactive calculation date picker to LegalCalculators.

description: SSRF vulnerability in URL proxy endpoint /api/lex/proxy.
evidence: Arbitrary external URLs passed in ?url= query could trigger redirect or proxy without domain validation.
remediation: Enforced strict hostname whitelist check: only lex.uz and www.lex.uz are permitted; external hosts or IP literals are blocked with 403 Forbidden.

description: Repealed 1995 Mehnat Kodeksi provisions (100-modda, 134-modda) referenced in user queries.
evidence: 1995 Labor Code was fully repealed effective 2023-04-30 by Law O‘RQ-798.
remediation: Classified as REPEALED in LegalDataRepository with validity interval 1996-04-01 to 2023-04-29; automatic redirection to in-force 161-modda and 217-modda.

description: Offline consult fallback injected hardcoded labor code citation (161-modda) when no statute matched query.
evidence: When matchedStatutes was empty, legalBasis array was populated with a hardcoded Mehnat kodeksi citation marked as verified.
remediation: Updated fallback to return empty legalBasis, confidenceLevel: LOW, and transparent notice that no verified statute was found for the query.

description: searchLawsDatabase lacked stop word filtering, causing common Uzbek grammatical particles to match random articles.
evidence: Query 'Noma‘lum mavzu bo‘yicha savol' matched articles because 'bo‘yicha' is present in nearly all legal texts.
remediation: Implemented STOP_WORDS filter in searchLawsDatabase; queries containing only functional words without keywords or article numbers return empty results.

description: Status bar displayed unverified '100% SINXRONLASHTIRILGAN' badge without actual synchronization backend.
evidence: Static text claimed 100% synchronization without querying live ingestion service.
remediation: Updated Navbar badge to reflect verified in-force edition (2026-yil) and added /api/lex/sync-status administrative endpoint.

description: Lack of version- and date-aware cache invalidation.
evidence: Session storage previously keyed only on URL and article without checking document version or target date.
remediation: Implemented LegalCacheManager with compound key (docId:articleNumber:targetDate:checksum), configurable TTL, and stale-cache fail-closed detection.

description: Absence of structured document ingestion quarantine mechanism.
evidence: Malformed or incomplete document structures could previously be loaded into application state without structural validation.
remediation: Built LegalIngestionService with mandatory field checks, effectiveFrom validation, provision integrity tests, and automatic quarantine logging.
